content:
A {h}wet colored paintbrush and a white house by {A}night.
A {h}landscape with a ploughman and another house be{A}side.
{h}Sunflowers and cornfields and an easel down be{A}low.
A {G}straw hat on a mournful face is {D}all that we {A}know.

Oil-colour-canvases and pictures in frames.
Who asks for paintings of a guy with no name?
Brother can you help me? I'm stone broke again.
Tomorrow I'll sell it all to an art businessman.

{h}Spot-painted poetry, {G}living in {A}quandary,
{h}Outside a gallery, {A}derided and {h}chased.
{h}Life is a lottery {G}without a {A}warranty,
{h}Dying in beggary, {A}buried in {h}haste.

Hard times for an artist with contrary mind
Scaremongers everywhere short-sighted and blind
Novelty was out of time boundary's effaced
It's better to make an end than to live in disgrace

Spot-painted poetry...
title: Vincent
